same_kind.v1/same_kind.instructions: Are the sessions of the first group and the sessions of the second group about the same kind of thing, so that one new kind would hold them all?

criteria.true: Both groups' sessions are about one kind of thing: each group's names and titles would fit the other, and the names differ in wording only.
criteria.false: The groups are about different kinds of things, or only share a word.
